units.source_text: 倾心于岛村的驹子，似乎在根性上也有某种内在的凉爽。

en.t: Komako, who had given her heart to Shimamura, seemed to possess some inner coolness deep in her nature.

units.source_text: 因此，在驹子身上迸发出的奔放的热情，使岛村觉得格外可怜。

en.t: Because of this, the unrestrained passion that burst forth from Komako made Shimamura feel all the more pity for her.
